$comment: Stage -> exit-command map (plan R2 section 3, R3). Every entry condition is a command or a checked artifact, never a sentence, and every exit is a command that exits 0 or non-zero.

stages.name: Canon profile, repo skeleton, conformance baseline
stages.entry: canon-profile.json exists with every Canon module classified and reasoned
stages.exitTest: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test -- --run && pnpm run health && pnpm run canon:audit

stages.name: Dolt data model and schema migrations
stages.exitTest: pnpm run db:migrate && pnpm run db:verify && pnpm run test -- src/adapters/dolt/schema.test.ts --run

stages.name: RFC 5546 conflict and sequence semantics as pure functions
stages.exitTest: pnpm run test -- src/domain/rfc5546 --run && pnpm run test -- src/domain/rfc5546/properties --run

stages.name: Recurrence with exceptions, and the timezone build step
stages.exitTest: pnpm run build:timezones && pnpm run test -- src/domain/recurrence --run

stages.name: Bidirectional change detection over Dolt history and diff
stages.exitTest: pnpm run test -- src/sync/changedetection --run && pnpm run sync:replay fixtures/replay-a --rounds 5

stages.name: Loop and duplicate prevention, proven by convergence
External provider adapters, starting with Google over CalDAV
stages.exitTest: pnpm run test -- src/adapters/caldav --run && pnpm run sync:measure --scenario realistic --assert-under <budget>

stages.name: Sync orchestration and quarantine
stages.exitTest: pnpm run sync:once --calendar <id> --dry-run --json | tee /tmp/plan.json && pnpm run sync:verify-plan /tmp/plan.json

stages.name: The TypeScript MCP interface
stages.exitTest: pnpm run test -- src/mcp --run && pnpm run mcp:smoke

stages.name: Repository-health convergence and unattended-work readiness
stages.exitTest: pnpm run size:check && pnpm run health && pnpm run type-check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test -- --run

stages.name: Migration and rollout
stages.entry: pnpm run test -- evidence/stage-09 --run && pnpm run sync:soak-report --since <N>d
stages.exitTest: pnpm run rollout:dry-run --scenario backfill && pnpm run rollout:rollback-drill && pnpm run test -- src/sync/rollout --run
